settings.question: Why is a skincare routine important?
settings.answer: Using the right products consistently, in the right order, helps each one do its job. A simple routine is easier to stick to than a complicated one.

settings.question: What is the correct order to apply products?
settings.answer: A common order is cleanse, treat (serums), moisturise, then finish with sunscreen in the morning. Always follow the directions on each product.

settings.question: Can I use several active ingredients together?
settings.answer: Introduce one new active at a time and patch-test first. If you are unsure whether two products can be combined, ask our team.

settings.question: Do I need sunscreen if I use exfoliating acids?
settings.answer: Yes. Daily broad-spectrum sun protection is recommended for everyone, and especially when using exfoliating or brightening products.
